probe_meta.label: dense-G (controlled retrieval-mechanism swap of Probe G)

response_text:
1. (Currently Amended) A process for obtaining a valued material from an aqueous suspension, dispersion or solution containing the valued material comprising adding to the aqueous suspension, dispersion or solution a Maillard reaction product __produced by heating an amine reactant and a reducing sugar together at a temperature of at least 50°C__, the Maillard reaction product comprising an adduct of (1) an amine reactant and (2) a reducing sugar, a reducing sugar equivalent, or a mixture thereof.

2. (Previously presented)

3. (Currently Amended) The process of claim 1, wherein the amine reactant contains at least one amine functional group, and wherein a molar ratio of the reducing sugar, the reducing sugar equivalent, or the mixture thereof to the amine functional group is about 1:1 to about 3:1, __and wherein the Maillard reaction product is formed through a Maillard browning reaction__.

4. (Currently Amended) The process of claim 1, wherein the reducing sugar, the reducing sugar equivalent, or the mixture thereof is selected from the group consisting of: dextrose, fructose, high fructose corn syrup, erythrulose, ribulose, xylulose, psicose, sorbose, tagatose, glyceraldehyde, erythrose, threose, ribose, arabinose, xylose, allose, altrose, mannose, gulose, galactose, talose, maltose, lactose, furfural, pyruvaldehyde, acetaldehyde, crotonaldehyde, 2-furaldehyde, glycolaldehyde, glycolaldehyde dimer, trans-3-(2-furyl)acrolein, acrolein, 5-hydroxymethylfurfural, 5-methylfurfural, 4-hydroxycrotonaldehyde, and cinnamaldehyde, and wherein the amine reactant is selected from the group consisting of: ammonia, ammonium hydroxide, hydrazine, guanidine, primary amines, secondary amines, quaternary ammonium compounds, polyamines, amino acids, and proteins, __and wherein the Maillard reaction product exhibits a brown color__.

5. (Currently Amended) The process of claim 1, wherein the Maillard reaction product has a cationic functionality, a sulfur functionality, a phosphorus functionality, a sulfate functionality, a sulfonate functionality, a hydroxamic acid functionality, a silane functionality, a phenolic functionality, or an aza crown chelating functionality, __and wherein the Maillard reaction product is formed through a thermal condensation reaction between the amine reactant and the reducing sugar__.

6. (Cancelled)

7. (Currently Amended) The process of claim 1, wherein the Maillard reaction product is produced by reacting the amine reactant, the reducing sugar, and a non-carbohydrate polyhydroxy reactant __under heating conditions__.

8. (Currently Amended) The process of claim 1, wherein the Maillard reaction product is produced by reacting the amine reactant, the reducing sugar, and a polycarboxylic acid __under heating conditions__.

9. (Currently Amended) The process of claim 1, wherein the valued material is obtained by sedimentation, filtration, or flotation, __and wherein the Maillard reaction product modifies the surface properties of the valued material or impurities to facilitate separation__.

10. (Currently Amended) The process of claim 1, further comprising recovering the value material from the aqueous suspension, dispersion or solution after adding the Maillard reaction product thereto to produce a purified product, wherein the purified product contains a reduced concentration of at least one impurity relative to the aqueous suspension, dispersion, or solution, __and wherein the Maillard reaction product acts as a collector or depressant to facilitate separation__.

11. (Cancelled)

12. (Previously presented)

13. (Currently Amended) A process for separating a valued material from a suspension, dispersion, or solution, comprising: treating the liquid suspension, dispersion, or solution with a Maillard reaction product __produced by heating an amine and a reducing sugar together at a temperature of at least 50°C__, of (1) an amine and (2) a reducing sugar, a reducing sugar equivalent, or a mixture thereof to provide a treated mixture; and removing a purified valued material from the treated mixture.

14. (Previously presented)

15. (Cancelled)

16. (Currently Amended) The process of claim 13, wherein the amine contains at least one amine functional group, and wherein a molar ratio of the reducing sugar, the reducing sugar equivalent, or the mixture thereof to the amine functional group is about 1:1 to about 3:1, __and wherein the Maillard reaction product is formed through a Maillard browning reaction__.

17. (Cancelled)

18. (Currently Amended) The process of claim 13, wherein the reducing sugar, the reducing sugar equivalent, or the mixture thereof is selected from the group consisting of: dextrose, fructose, high fructose corn syrup, erythrulose, ribulose, xylulose, psicose, sorbose, tagatose, glyceraldehyde, erythrose, threose, ribose, arabinose, xylose, allose, altrose, mannose, gulose, galactose, talose, maltose, lactose, furfural, pyruvaldehyde, acetaldehyde, crotonaldehyde, 2-furaldehyde, glycolaldehyde, glycolaldehyde dimer, trans-3-(2-furyl)acrolein, acrolein, 5-hydroxymethylfurfural, 5-methylfurfural, 4-hydroxycrotonaldehyde, and cinnamaldehyde, and wherein the amine is selected from the group consisting of: ammonia, ammonium hydroxide, hydrazine, guanidine, primary amines, secondary amines, quaternary ammonium compounds, polyamines, amino acids, and proteins, __and wherein the Maillard reaction product exhibits a brown color__.

19. (Currently Amended) The process of claim 13, wherein the Maillard reaction product depresses the value material or an impurity present in the treated mixture, or wherein the Maillard reaction product promotes flotation of the value material or the impurity in the treated mixture, __and wherein the Maillard reaction product modifies the surface properties of the valued material or impurities__.

20. (Currently Amended) The process of claim 13, wherein the purified valued material is removed from the treated mixture by sedimentation, filtration, or flotation, __and wherein the Maillard reaction product acts as a collector or depressant to facilitate separation__.
